title: Public website Integrations catalog: local filters, availability and documentation navigation
goal: Browse the public /integrations catalog without treating descriptive availability or operation models as current account access, connection health, execution permission or provider action.
prerequisites: Internal source-only draft for the public WEBSITE /integrations page. This is not desktop Apps & skills, Settings Integrations, account connection manager or a claim of their coverage.
No account identity/current connection/provider health/permission/runtime flag was read. Catalog metadata, not an account-status request, supplies cards and filters.
Historical479ac14a guide/build references remain historical context; this article binds currentbe276403 source only, without new browser/build/shipped acceptance.
permissions: Catalog browsing starts no connection, grants no permission and performs no provider action. Search/select/reset/disclosure change local presentation state, not OAuth consent or capabilities.

Available/configuration/preview/review/planned labels describe catalog release/design limits. Existing workflows still need current account configuration and operation-specific checks; labels are not live account status/health or grants.
Read context/Change workflows/Receive events are passive metadata, not action buttons. A planned/reviewed card can list operation models without released execution.

Documentation/download navigation does not authenticate, validate connection, approve change or execute provider operation. Separate supported setup, genuine human review and execution controls retain their own authority.

steps.instruction: Open the public /integrations page; read the catalog-only header and limitation text.
steps.expectedState: This is a public catalog, not your signed-in account connection screen or desktop app. Shared site navigation/footer and destination workflows are outside this article.

steps.instruction: Use Search connectors to enter a connector name.
steps.expectedState: Case-insensitive name-only substring after trimming whitespace. Does not search descriptions, operation names, documentation, jobs or provider data. Typing sends no provider request.

steps.instruction: Choose Job: All jobs, Cloud delivery, Source & CI, Work tracking, Communication, Orchestration & observability or Data.
steps.expectedState: Catalog categories, not selected workspace/account scopes. Filter combines with search, availability and operation as intersection.

steps.instruction: Choose Availability: All availability, Available workflows, Configuration required, Preview or review, Planned.
steps.expectedState: Preview or review includes preview and implementation review. Filtering does not inspect account connection, change availability or enable setup.

steps.instruction: Choose Operation model: All operation models, Read context, Change workflows, Receive events.
steps.expectedState: Derived typed catalog descriptions only. Change workflows grants no write scope. Card Operation models group is passive text and may describe planned/review designs.

steps.instruction: Read polite connectors shown/in catalog count and Job-grouped cards. Use Clear filters or empty-state Clear filters when appropriate.
steps.expectedState: Reset clears search and all three selectors. No connectors match these filters means empty intersection, not permission failure/disconnection; reset does not change connector readiness.

steps.instruction: Inspect name, availability and provider-specific limitation paragraph. Use Read setup guide, Read preview scope or Browse documentation only where offered.
steps.expectedState: Ordinary existing documentation/product navigation, not OAuth/connect/validation/execution. Planned/disabled entries say No setup available yet without setup link. Available remains conditional on current account and exact operation checks.

steps.instruction: Expand How to read availability; inspect Before you connect and choose Connection guide, Permission model or Desktop downloads if needed.
steps.expectedState: Native HTML disclosure explains available/configuration/preview/implementation review/planned limits. Links target /docs/integration-setup, /docs/permissions-model and /download; no connection approval/provider action from catalog, and destination success is unverified.

expectedOutcome: Find relevant catalog entries and next documentation destination while retaining the distinction between descriptive capability metadata and actual current supported, authorized account operations.
limitations: Customer eligible:false; publication approved:false; editorial/media/native/runtime/release/shipped acceptance:false. Null review and empty media. Proposed IDs are authoring-only, not runtime anchors/help bindings.

Scope exclusively public WEBSITE /integrations filters/cards/availability disclosure/before-connect links. No desktop Apps & skills, account connection manager, Settings workflow, shared header/footer or all-site/backend coverage.

All4historical embedded whole-file hashes match currentbe276403; current receipt adds exact inclusive raw ranges. Historical479guide/build/HTTP evidence is preserved, not new current build/browser/runtime qualification.

Availability metadata is not current account connection, authentication, access, provider-health, permissions or flag state. A listed Change workflows model does not activate execution or grant scope; planned GitLab-style entry is not customer-ready sign-in/setup.

No destination OAuth/account signup/setup/permission validation/download/install outcome or provider delivery was exercised. Reading setup docs cannot make a required independent human decision or execute changes.

No current screenshot/media/browser keyboard/screen-reader/native acceptance or security certification. Source hashes/schema validation prove source identity/bundle integrity only, not semantic/runtime/shipped behavior.
Evaluation fixture is proposed-not-executed; no retrieval/model evaluation, customer ingestion, publication, feature/authority/activation or provider operation is created.
recovery: For no matching entries clear/change intersecting filters; do not diagnose missing permission or disconnected account from an empty catalog result.
Read provider-specific limitation and availability explanation before navigating to a separate supported setup guide. A documentation link is not consent or current provider validation.
If an entry is planned/disabled there is no setup control here; do not infer an unpublished activation path or use another operation label to bypass absence.
For actual account/connection/permission problems use separately authorized account/desktop workflow; this public catalog cannot inspect, refresh or repair account state.
